newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic to buy Marketing Corp units.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic to buy Marketing Corp units.

text.p: The Interpublic Group of Companies Inc said Thursday that it has agreed to acquire the marketing service businesses of Marketing Corp of America which it said has capitalized billings of almost $300 million.
Terms of acquisition, which will be subject to review under the provisions of the Hart Scott Rodino act, were not disclosed.

The four marketing services divisions being acquired are the Management Consulting Group, the Information Resources Division, the MCA Marketing Agency and Lee Hill, Inc, promotional development and loyalty marketing specialists.
The Interpublic Group of Companies is one of the world's largest groups of advertising agencies and related marketing service companies.
